payload.hypothesis: The administrators' field addressing comes from MIXING two views of the same group record: struct subscript for enabled/volume plus a WaveGroupList reference pinned at &groups_[a1].head for head/cursor. VC6's CSE then unifies the shared base as esi = this + 24*a1 WITHOUT folding the array base 0x24 into the lea, giving the image's exact displacements (+0x24 enabled, +0x28 volume, +0x2c head, +0x34 cursor). A pure struct view (`WaveControlGroup &group`) folds +0x24 into the lea and lands every disp 8 bytes off — this, not the inline/outline question, is what sank the earlier experiments.
